name: Investcorp
via: Bahrain-based global alternative investment manager; delisted from the Bahrain Bourse in 2021 and converted into a closed shareholding (private) company
note: Mubadala, Abu Dhabi's state investment company, agreed in July 2016 to take a 20% interest in Investcorp and was still described as its biggest shareholder at the 2021 delisting (claims mubadala-investcorp-stake, poc-investcorp-ownership). Its private-equity portfolio includes POC, the Swedish helmet and protection brand, acquired from Black Diamond.
